tiers.name: Read-Only Projection
forbidden_operations: any agent tool execution that mutates
required_redaction_scan: content-light projection validation
public/private split for static docs
tiers.failure_behavior: show stale/blocked state indicator; never fabricate data; surface trust_spine_incomplete or permission_probe_stale

tiers.name: Local Intent Submission
allowed_operations: send chat messages to agent loop
required_redaction_scan: intent payload must not contain raw secrets
proposed changes hash-checked before storage
tiers.failure_behavior: return blocked decision with reason codes; surface 'why blocked' explanation

tiers.name: Local Mutation
allowed_operations: write files to local workspace (with dirty guard)
required_redaction_scan: subprocess output sanitization
env var stripping before subprocess
no secrets in checkpoint metadata
required_audit_logs: file mutation events with path hashes
tiers.failure_behavior: refuse mutation with structured refusal code; record refusal as evidence

tiers.name: Remote Read
forbidden_operations: ingest untrusted payloads without schema validation
required_approval_gates: GitHub Provider Trust Spine v1 complete
required_redaction_scan: alert content must not leak secret fragments
API responses must be content-light before storage
webhook payloads validated before processing
required_audit_logs: webhook delivery id/event id with signature verification result
tiers.failure_behavior: defer request if rate-limited; quarantine invalid webhooks; surface permission_probe_stale if probe expired

tiers.name: Remote Mutation
forbidden_operations: remote mutation without signed approval receipt
push without content-light scan of PR body/comments
required_approval_gates: GitHub Provider Trust Spine v1 complete
permission probe current with write scope confirmed
explicit human approval with signed receipt
required_redaction_scan: PR body must not contain raw prompts/completions
PR comments must not contain marketing text
no hidden co-author attribution
no secret-bearing content in mutation payload
tiers.failure_behavior: block mutation; return refusal with reason code; record blocked mutation as evidence; surface 'why blocked' in cockpit

tiers.name: Admin / Configuration
forbidden_operations: modify schema-governed artifacts without diffable evidence
required_receipt_evidence: config change receipts with before/after hashes
required_redaction_scan: config changes must not expose secrets in change diff
admin logs must not contain raw credentials
tiers.failure_behavior: refuse config change; return explanation; record refusal; require re-submission with corrections

tiers.name: Inter-Agent Delegation (A2A)
allowed_operations: receive delegated task results with evidence
forbidden_operations: delegate tasks that bypass Rig Relay mission governance
accept tasks from unverified remote agents
delegate mutations without explicit trust tier
accept Agent Cards that have changed without diff review
required_approval_gates: trust tier verification for remote agent
scope boundary enforcement for delegated task
Agent Card hash verification (signed or hash-pinned)
required_redaction_scan: Agent Cards must be content-light
delegated task input/output must not contain raw prompts/secrets
cross-agent evidence must preserve content-light guarantees
tiers.failure_behavior: refuse delegation; return structured refusal to delegating agent; record refusal as coordination evidence; surface delegation blocked in cockpit and A2A protocol

tiers.name: Hosted Multi-Tenant Operation
allowed_operations: serve multiple tenants from shared infrastructure
forbidden_operations: disable enterprise audit evidence for any tenant
allow one tenant to consume another tenant's rate-limit
bypass product telemetry opt-out for enterprise evidence
required_approval_gates: RBAC role verification for admin operations
required_redaction_scan: tenant identifiers hashed in cross-tenant telemetry
no tenant A's data in tenant B's projection
Postgres query isolation at connection/schema level
required_tests: product telemetry opt-out per tenant preserves audit
tiers.failure_behavior: fail closed: if tenant isolation cannot be guaranteed, degrade to single-tenant or refuse to start; surface hosted_mode_unavailable in cockpit

tiers.name: Public Static Projection
allowed_operations: generate public static docs from content-light artifacts
serve public pages via GitHub Pages
forbidden_operations: expose secret-bearing or forbidden raw content
required_approval_gates: schema validation of all source artifacts
required_receipt_evidence: page generation receipts with source artifact refs
required_redaction_scan: pre-deploy content-light scan must block any secret-bearing or forbidden raw content
public pages must be verified content-light before deployment
required_tests: no raw secrets in static output
tiers.failure_behavior: block deployment; return scan results with violation details; surface deployment blocked in CI; never deploy pages that fail content-light scan
